web.title: Supabase Free Tier Limits 2026: Database, Projects, Pausing
web.description:
**Supabase free tier limits in 2026: two active projects, a 500 MB database per project on shared compute, file storage, monthly quotas on egress, active users and Edge Function invocations, and unlimited API requests.**

## What are the Supabase free tier limits?
Each gets a 500 MB database on shared compute, 1 GB of file storage, 5 GB of egress, 50,000 monthly active users, 500,000 Edge Function invocations, 200 Realtime connections and unlimited API requests.

| Limit | Free plan |
|-|-|
| Database size | 500 MB per project |

### Database: 500 MB per project
Each free project runs on shared compute with 500 MB RAM and a 500 MB database. That is enough for many early products, but it fills faster than you expect if you store JSON blobs, logs or audit trails in tables.

The database allows a limited number of direct connections and 200 pooler connections. For low-traffic apps that is enough. If you start hitting connection errors, route your traffic through the pooler. Connection limits only rise from the Small compute size upwards, which is a paid add-on on Pro.

## What happens when you hit a Supabase free tier limit?
Going over the 500 MB database quota brings warnings and possible restrictions after a grace period.

## What does upgrading to Supabase Pro get you in 2026?
| Feature | Free | Pro ($25 a month) |
|-|-|-|
| Database size | 500 MB | 8 GB, then $0.125 per GB |

### When Team makes sense
![Comparison table of Supabase Free and Pro: database size, file storage, egress, monthly active users, backups and pausing](https://aiagencyplus.com/wp-content/uploads/supabase-free-tier-limits-supabase-free-vs-pro-at-a-glance.png)Pro is $25 a month per organisation; compute is billed per project, with $10 of compute credits included.

## Frequently asked questions
### How much data can I store in Supabase for free?
If the database goes over 500 MB and stays over past a grace period, Supabase can apply Fair Use restrictions such as read-only mode, pausing the project or 402 errors.

# Supabase pricing: plans, free tier limits, and the bills AI is quietly creating
Supabase offers four plans: Free ($0, two projects, 500 MB database each), Pro ($25 per organization per month plus usage), Team ($599 per month, adds SOC 2 and SSO), and Enterprise (custom).

Database launches on Supabase [grew more than 600% in a single year, and over 60% of them were launched by an AI tool](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/05/supabase-doubles-valuation-to-10b-in-8-months/), not a person.

## How much does Supabase cost?
| Plan | Base price | What it adds | Built for |
|-|-|-|-|
| Free | $0 | 2 projects, 500 MB database each, community support | Prototypes, MVPs, learning |
| Pro | $25/org/month + usage | 8 GB database, 100 GB storage, no pausing, $10 compute credit | Production apps |

## What are the Supabase free tier limits?
| Free tier resource | Included limit |
|-|-|
| Database size | 500 MB per project |
| Database egress | 5 GB |

## What does the Pro plan really cost in production?
It lifts each database to 8 GB, file storage to 100 GB, egress to 250 GB, auth to 100,000 monthly active users, and removes the inactivity pause.

## Frequently asked questions about Supabase pricing
Supabase is genuinely free for two active projects, each with a 500 MB database, 1 GB file storage, 5 GB egress, and 50,000 monthly active users.

Pro at $25 per organization per month lifts each database from 500 MB to 8 GB, file storage from 1 GB to 100 GB, and auth from 50,000 to 100,000 monthly active users.
